article.title: Cloud Cost Optimization Playbook: Cut Your Cloud Bill by 30% in 90 Days
article.body_markdown:
# Cloud Cost Optimization Playbook: Cut Your Cloud Bill by 30% in 90 Days Without Breaking Anything

Cloud bills creep up on you. One day it's $500/month, the next it's $5,000. But you can't just start shutting things down—that's how you cause outages.

Here's a 90-day playbook that actually works. Four phases, 30% savings, zero downtime.

## The 90-Day Timeline

- **Days 1-15**: Discovery & Baseline
- **Days 16-45**: Quick Wins (10-15% savings)
- **Days 46-75**: Deep Optimization (15-20% savings)
- **Days 76-90**: Automation & Governance (5-10% ongoing savings)

## Phase 1: Discovery (Days 1-15)

You can't optimize what you don't understand.

☐ Export last 90 days of billing data from all providers
☐ Tag every resource with project, environment, owner
☐ Identify your top 10 cost centers
☐ Map actual utilization (CPU, memory, storage, network)
☐ Review reserved instances vs actual usage

## Phase 2: Quick Wins (Days 16-45)

Easy fixes that save money immediately.

☐ Shut down non-prod nights and weekends
☐ Delete unused volumes and snapshots older than 30 days
☐ Rightsize oversized instances based on actual utilization
☐ Move infrequent storage to cheaper tiers (S3 IA, Glacier)
☐ Enable auto-scaling for predictable workloads

*Result: 10-15% savings, zero risk*

## Phase 3: Deep Optimization (Days 46-75)

Strategic changes that need planning.

☐ Purchase reserved instances for baseline workloads
☐ Implement spot instances for fault-tolerant workloads
☐ Consolidate accounts for volume discounts
☐ Optimize data transfer (CDNs, regional endpoints)
☐ Review and reduce software licenses

*Result: 15-20% additional savings*

## Phase 4: Automation (Days 76-90)

Build systems that prevent cost creep.

☐ Set up budget alerts at 50%, 75%, 90% of monthly spend
☐ Implement cost allocation tags for chargebacks
☐ Create resource approval workflows
☐ Schedule regular cost reviews (weekly ops, monthly finance)
☐ Build cost optimization into CI/CD pipelines

*Result: 5-10% ongoing savings*

## Common Pitfalls to Avoid

❌ **Don't optimize in production without testing** – Always test in staging first.

❌ **Don't forget egress costs** – Data transfer out often costs more than compute.

❌ **Don't ignore security requirements** – Cheaper instances might lack compliance features.

❌ **Don't set and forget** – Usage patterns change. Review quarterly.

## Tools That Actually Help

**Native:** AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, GCP Cost Dashboard

**Third-party:** CloudHealth, Cloudability, ParkMyCloud

**Open source:** CloudCheckr, custom scripts

## The Reality Check

Most teams see 20-25% savings in the first 60 days. The remaining 5-10% comes from ongoing governance.

But here's what matters: you now understand exactly where your money goes and why.
